BEHIND THE FILTER

Asap bukan filter.
Karhutla belum usai.

Karhutla means kebakaran hutan dan lahan — forest and land fires. This independent project uses a profile picture as a reminder to keep paying attention.

These colors are artistic interpretations. They aren't current conditions, air-quality readings, or evidence of a fire.

Your picture stays yours.

Photos are opened and edited in your browser's memory. This version does not upload or store them on a server, use analytics, load ads, or use cookies. The web host may keep standard request logs.

Downloading saves a new PNG on your device. The export doesn't copy the original file's metadata. The caption button copies only the campaign text, after you click it.

This is an independent awareness project, not an official organization or a donation platform. Advertising, if introduced, will be labeled and the privacy information will be updated before launch.
